module: McAfee Database Security Sensor Cryptographic Module
caveat: When operated in FIPS mode and when installed, initialized and configured as specified in the Security Policy Section 4
description: The McAfee Database Security Sensor Cryptographic Module Version 1.0, is a software shared library that provides cryptographic services required by the McAfee Database Security Sensor.

Solaris 9 running on a Sun UltraSPARC C-III (single-user mode)

Windows Server 2008 64-bit with VMWare ESXi 5.0 running on a HP Proliant DL380 GS
Windows Server 2008 R2 64-bit with VMWare ESXi 4.0 running on a HP Proliant DL185 GS
